description.en: Semantic, accessible Tailwind CSS component library ready for Tailwind v4.
description.zh: 面向 Tailwind CSS v4 打造的无障碍、语义化类名全套组件库。

content.en: FlyonUI is an open-source, semantic Tailwind CSS component library combining semantic markup, built-in JavaScript interactivity, and Tailwind CSS v4 support. Designed for speed and developer ergonomics, it includes over 80 responsive components with rich theme presets.
content.zh: FlyonUI 是一套全新开源的语义化 Tailwind CSS 组件库，原生准备好拥抱 Tailwind CSS v4 架构。它将精简的语义化类名与免配置的原生 JS 交互结合，收录超 80 个高响应式组件与丰富的主题变体，兼顾轻量体积与极速开发体验。
